name: g22_foreign_weather
purpose: The Speed abilities in a weather that is not theirs change nothing: Basculegion (Swift Swim, 98 Speed) and Beartic (Slush Rush, 70) in the sun of Ninetales, Basculegion in the snow of Abomasnow after it, then Houndstone (Sand Rush, 88) and Venusaur (Chlorophyll, 100) in that snow: the foes at 101 to 120 Speed move before them as they do without weather.
